crossRefs.note: You shall make twenty boards for the tabernacle, for the south side southward.

translations.web: You shall make twenty boards for the tabernacle, for the south side southward.
translations.bsb: Construct twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle,
translations.kjv: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards on the south side southward.
translations.asv: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward.
